title: EvidenceCitation
description: The core's INTERNAL citation record: everything of the client-facing Citation (urn:alixai:schema:conversation:citation:v1, master plan 12.5) plus the two internal source-metadata members of the external-provider seam, source_egress and source_classification. It is built by the core after the final authorisation and version recheck and is NEVER serialised to a client: the answer API and the stream expose the conversation Citation, which has no member for either value and, being a closed object, rejects them. The projection from this record to the client Citation is exactly 'drop source_egress and source_classification'; a test keeps the two property lists in step. The members both records share have the same definitions as the conversation Citation: they are $refs into it where the generator can express that and exact copies where it cannot (display_name, claims), and a test compares the two schemas member by member so they cannot drift. When no authorised evidence supports an answer there is no citation at all: the result is NoSupportedEvidence.

display_name.description: The source's name as the requesting principal is authorised to see it.

version.description: Source version or content hash the answer was grounded on.

locator.description: Where in the source the evidence sits, when known: a page, a section, a record or a character span.

availability.description: Whether the source can still be opened by this principal: available, unavailable or removed.

staleness.description: Whether the cited version is the latest: current, stale or unknown.

open_ref.description: Permission-checked, opaque way to open or preview the source; never a URL or a path.

claims.description: The answer claims this source supports, one short statement each, as verified by the core's claim/source check. At least one.

source_egress.description: INTERNAL. What an external provider may receive from this source, copied from the source's declaration when the citation is built. Missing means local_only. Never exposed to a client.

source_classification.description: INTERNAL. The data classification of this source, copied from the source's declaration when the citation is built. Missing means restricted. Never exposed to a client.
